intent_anchor.user_goal: Build a dependable AIdle Private Reality persistence layer without disrupting the installed-subagent workflow.
intent_anchor.current_priority: Accept G4 only when persistence is active in runtime and the locked signed-journal boundary is evidenced.

claim_under_review: Directive 12 G4-001 is ready for final acceptance.
what_i_accept: Independent persist smoke passes 11 checks with clean logs.
Save/reload hashes are stable and duplicate requests are idempotent.
Stale revision and malformed journal paths fail closed.
Compensation is append-only and G3 revision 3 is preserved.
All six MAF receipts validate and no writer conflict exists.
The module correctly rejects Shared District and server-economy authority claims.
what_i_challenge: Integrated boot still mounts AgentPersistStub rather than PersistModule.
Executor does not consume PersistModule through an explicit offline Private Reality gate.
Architecture Lock requires a local signed journal, but no signature, HMAC or entry hash chain exists.
strongest_counter_argument: A standalone passing module is not yet an active game capability, and an unsigned append-only JSON journal cannot meet the locked signed-journal integrity claim.
missing_evidence: Integrated boot marker proving PersistModule replaced the stub.
A consumer test proving only explicitly gated offline Private Reality operations reach the journal.
Wrong-key, entry-tamper, removal and reorder tests for keyed journal integrity.
The installed adversarial-review skill references absent schema files, so this object follows its documented fields but could not be schema-validated.
blind_spots: Device key provisioning must remain local and must not become an API credential or server-authority claim.
next_action: Run a bounded persist/core correction with schema and network verification in the same Grok parent.
